author: Stephanie Johnson
text: I had that very same thing happen to the very first sensor I put on. It lasted 9 days and I noticed it was consistently showing readings in the 60s and wouldn’t move. I did a finger stick and was at 150. SO very annoying that the FreeStyle Libre 3+ is no better than the Dexcom G7. I changed to the Freestyle because I was having such issues with the Dexcom and now I find out the Freestyle is no better.

author: Dillon Finlay
text: Go to https://www.freestylecheck.com/ and enter the serial numbers. The 3 and 3+ sensors have a recall for an issue like that.
